mapper.sql: pref_id, user_id, notification_type, channel_inapp_yn, channel_email_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_notification_pref WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY (notification_type = 'ALL') DESC, notification_type ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_notification_pref ( pref_id, user_id, notification_type, channel_inapp_yn, channel_email_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{prefId}, #{userId}, #{notificationType}, #{channelInappYn}, #{channelEmailYn}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO tb_notification_pref ( pref_id, user_id, notification_type, channel_inapp_yn, channel_email_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{prefId}, #{userId}, #{notificationType}, #{channelInappYn}, #{channelEmailYn}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE channel_inapp_yn = VALUES(channel_inapp_yn), channel_email_yn = VALUES(channel_email_yn), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_ip = VALUES(updated_ip), updated_at = NOW()
